item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00183","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C16","C25","C02"],"selected_candidate_label":"C16","confidence":0.94,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C16 is a direct documentary precursor in the same steel dispute and supplies material factual and administrative content reused in the child. It establishes the referral to the Wage Stabilization Board, the Board's role in investigating and recommending a settlement, the failure of bargaining and mediation, the threatened industry-wide stoppage, and the defense consequences of lost steel production. The child later relies on substantially this same machinery and sequence to explain why fact-finding and delay had already been exhausted and why continued steel production was imperative. C25 has a weaker parallel involving threatened seizure of another industry and a request for constructive congressional legislation, while C02 repeats the same Wage Stabilization Board referral template but for petroleum and is less directly connected to the child's factual account.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"In the present case, we have had a board which made a thorough study and investigation-and-recommendation process initiated by C16."},{"child_excerpt":"There is nothing in the situation to suggest that further fact finding and further delay would bring about a
